messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
river_wonders | River Wonders | 43 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
wings_of_time | Wings of Time | 19 | 20 | 19:30-21:30 | 19:40, 20:40
oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
singapore_zoo | Singapore Zoo | 49 | 240 | 08:30-18:00 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
clarke_quay: national_gallery 12, universal_studios 22, river_wonders 44, wings_of_time 24, oceanarium 22, singapore_zoo 44, singapore_flyer 15, bird_paradise 45, national_museum 12
national_gallery: clarke_quay 12, universal_studios 23, river_wonders 45, wings_of_time 24, oceanarium 22, singapore_zoo 45, singapore_flyer 14, bird_paradise 46, national_museum 12
universal_studios: clarke_quay 22, national_gallery 23, river_wonders 51, wings_of_time 12, oceanarium 12, singapore_zoo 51, singapore_flyer 25, bird_paradise 52, national_museum 24
river_wonders: clarke_quay 44, national_gallery 45, universal_studios 51, wings_of_time 52, oceanarium 50, singapore_zoo 11, singapore_flyer 47, bird_paradise 12, national_museum 43
wings_of_time: clarke_quay 24, national_gallery 24, universal_studios 12, river_wonders 52, oceanarium 13, singapore_zoo 52, singapore_flyer 26, bird_paradise 52, national_museum 25
oceanarium: clarke_quay 22, national_gallery 22, universal_studios 12, river_wonders 50, wings_of_time 13, singapore_zoo 50, singapore_flyer 25, bird_paradise 51, national_museum 23
singapore_zoo: clarke_quay 44, national_gallery 45, universal_studios 51, river_wonders 11, wings_of_time 52, oceanarium 50, singapore_flyer 46, bird_paradise 12, national_museum 43
singapore_flyer: clarke_quay 15, national_gallery 14, universal_studios 25, river_wonders 47, wings_of_time 26, oceanarium 25, singapore_zoo 46, bird_paradise 48, national_museum 15
bird_paradise: clarke_quay 45, national_gallery 46, universal_studios 52, river_wonders 12, wings_of_time 52, oceanarium 51, singapore_zoo 12, singapore_flyer 48, national_museum 44
national_museum: clarke_quay 12, national_gallery 12, universal_studios 24, river_wonders 43, wings_of_time 25, oceanarium 23, singapore_zoo 43, singapore_flyer 15, bird_paradise 44

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

I'm free from 09:00 to 17:15. Money is not a concern. I definitely need to see National Gallery Singapore and National Museum of Singapore. Optionally, Clarke Quay, Universal Studios Singapore, River Wonders, Wings of Time, Singapore Oceanarium, Singapore Zoo, Singapore Flyer and Bird Paradise. I'd like to spend 180 minutes at National Gallery Singapore. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Singapore Flyer.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Place data: id, cost, default_duration, open_start, open_end, showtimes
places = {
    "clarke_quay": {"cost": 30, "duration": 90, "open": 1020, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "national_gallery": {"cost": 25, "duration": 150, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "universal_studios": {"cost": 83, "duration": 480, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "river_wonders": {"cost": 43, "duration": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "wings_of_time": {"cost": 19, "duration": 20, "open": 1170, "close": 1290, "shows": [1180, 1240]},
    "oceanarium": {"cost": 50, "duration": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "singapore_zoo": {"cost": 49, "duration": 240, "open": 510, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "singapore_flyer": {"cost": 40, "duration": 45, "open": 600, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "bird_paradise": {"cost": 49, "duration": 180, "open": 540, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "duration": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
}

# Custom durations specified by user
custom_durations = {
    "national_gallery": 180,
    "singapore_flyer": 30
}

# Travel times matrix
travel_times = {
    "clarke_quay": {"national_gallery": 12, "universal_studios": 22, "river_wonders": 44, "wings_of_time": 24, "oceanarium": 22, "singapore_zoo": 44, "singapore_flyer": 15, "bird_paradise": 45, "national_museum": 12},
    "national_gallery": {"clarke_quay": 12, "universal_studios": 23, "river_wonders": 45, "wings_of_time": 24, "oceanarium": 22, "singapore_zoo": 45, "singapore_flyer": 14, "bird_paradise": 46, "national_museum": 12},
    "universal_studios": {"clarke_quay": 22, "national_gallery": 23, "river_wonders": 51, "wings_of_time": 12, "oceanarium": 12, "singapore_zoo": 51, "singapore_flyer": 25, "bird_paradise": 52, "national_museum": 24},
    "river_wonders": {"clarke_quay": 44, "national_gallery": 45, "universal_studios": 51, "wings_of_time": 52, "oceanarium": 50, "singapore_zoo": 11, "singapore_flyer": 47, "bird_paradise": 12, "national_museum": 43},
    "wings_of_time": {"clarke_quay": 24, "national_gallery": 24, "universal_studios": 12, "river_wonders": 52, "oceanarium": 13, "singapore_zoo": 52, "singapore_flyer": 26, "bird_paradise": 52, "national_museum": 25},
    "oceanarium": {"clarke_quay": 22, "national_gallery": 22, "universal_studios": 12, "river_wonders": 50, "wings_of_time": 13, "singapore_zoo": 50, "singapore_flyer": 25, "bird_paradise": 51, "national_museum": 23},
    "singapore_zoo": {"clarke_quay": 44, "national_gallery": 45, "universal_studios": 51, "river_wonders": 11, "wings_of_time": 52, "oceanarium": 50, "singapore_flyer": 46, "bird_paradise": 12, "national_museum": 43},
    "singapore_flyer": {"clarke_quay": 15, "national_gallery": 14, "universal_studios": 25, "river_wonders": 47, "wings_of_time": 26, "oceanarium": 25, "singapore_zoo": 46, "bird_paradise": 48, "national_museum": 15},
    "bird_paradise": {"clarke_quay": 45, "national_gallery": 46, "universal_studios": 52, "river_wonders": 12, "wings_of_time": 52, "oceanarium": 51, "singapore_zoo": 12, "singapore_flyer": 48, "national_museum": 44},
    "national_museum": {"clarke_quay": 12, "national_gallery": 12, "universal_studios": 24, "river_wonders": 43, "wings_of_time": 25, "oceanarium": 23, "singapore_zoo": 43, "singapore_flyer": 15, "bird_paradise": 44}
}

def get_travel_time(p1, p2):
    if p1 == p2:
        return 0
    return travel_times[p1][p2]

# User constraints
day_start = 540  # 09:00
day_end = 1035   # 17:15
must_visit = {"national_gallery", "national_museum"}

s = Solver()

# Variables per place
is_visited = {}
start_time = {}
end_time = {}

for pid in places:
    is_visited[pid] = Bool(f"visit_{pid}")
    start_time[pid] = Int(f"start_{pid}")
    end_time[pid] = Int(f"end_{pid}")

# Must-visit constraints
for pid in must_visit:
    s.add(is_visited[pid] == True)

for pid, data in places.items():
    dur = custom_durations.get(pid, data["duration"])
    
    # Time bounds and open hours
    s.add(start_time[pid] >= day_start)
    s.add(end_time[pid] <= day_end)
    s.add(start_time[pid] >= data["open"])
    s.add(end_time[pid] <= data["close"])
    s.add(end_time[pid] == start_time[pid] + dur)
    
    # If not visited, maybe constrain start/end or just rely on logic? 
    # Standard approach: bounds apply universally, but we only care if visited.
    # Actually, if not visited, start/end can be anything as long as they don't break logic, 
    # but let's constrain them to valid range.
    
    # Showtimes constraint
    if data["shows"]:
        show_conditions = [start_time[pid] == st for st in data["shows"]]
        s.add(Or(Not(is_visited[pid]), Or(show_conditions)))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints between all pairs of visited places
place_list = list(places.keys())
for i in range(len(place_list)):
    for j in range(len(place_list)):
        if i != j:
            p1 = place_list[i]
            p2 = place_list[j]
            tt = get_travel_time(p1, p2)
            
            # If both p1 and p2 are visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2.start OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1.start
            s.add(
                Or(
                    Not(is_visited[p1]),
                    Not(is_visited[p2]),
                    end_time[p1] + tt <= start_time[p2],
                    end_time[p2] + tt <= start_time[p1]
                )
            )

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for pid in place_list:
        if m.evaluate(is_visited[pid]):
            st = m.evaluate(start_time[pid]).as_long()
            et = m.evaluate(end_time[pid]).as_long()
            result.append({
                "location_id": pid,
                "start": st,
                "end": et
            })
    # Sort by start time just to be clean
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
